end.summary:
Discussed why sharing household work helps families care for one another.
Trisha named family members’ roles and suggested lifting toys, bringing a sandwich, and carrying a water bottle.
Practised that children can also take part in family and class responsibilities.
Trisha continued to say that children are too small for most helping tasks; this was not fully corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sharing household work through family and classroom examples. Trisha identified putting away toys and managing their own bag and bottle as ways to help, and suggested dividing class tasks among children. The mix-up that children are too small to help remained at the end. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small daily task, such as putting away toys or placing their bag and bottle in their places.
